name: trainer-framework-specific-ml-policy-09c9
instr:
Let callers inspect a stable, pre-materialization explanation of how Kubeflow Trainer resolves ML policies. The report should make framework choices and failures understandable while leaving enforcement, admission, and workload construction behavior unchanged.

Reporting is deterministic and read-only: it neither mutates its inputs nor changes any subsequently materialized object, value, or ordering, and repeated equivalent resolutions are equal. Mixed policies emit decisions in framework execution order and preserve each plugin's internal emission order. Every enforcement policy, including PlainML, Torch, XGBoost, JAX, MPI, and Flux, completely explains its topology, defaults, resources, identities, targets, environment, infrastructure, exemptions, and skipped or invalid outcomes from the same inputs used for enforcement. Aggregation stops at the first plugin failure, identifies that plugin, preserves the completed prefix, and excludes later plugins. Namespaced and cluster templates resolve equivalently through `pkg/runtime/core.NewTrainingRuntime`, `pkg/runtime/core.NewClusterTrainingRuntime`, or `pkg/runtime/core.New` before materialization. Admission observes the persisted runtime report reconciliation will use, exposes resolution failures before infrastructure creation, and preserves existing warnings and field errors. `DecisionCategory` and `DecisionOutcome` from `github.com/kubeflow/trainer/v2/pkg/runtime/policyreport` are string types; `DecisionApplied`, `DecisionSkip
